test_cases.name: Managed identity authentication
test_cases.input_setup: Configure AI_FOUNDRY_AUTH_METHOD=managed_identity without static API key
test_cases.expected_result: Auth resolves to Entra ID token provider with Cognitive Services scope
test_cases.evidence: Managed Identity auth configured with Azure Cognitive Services token scope: https://cognitiveservices.azure.com/.default

test_cases.name: Least privilege role enforcement
test_cases.input_setup: Verify RBAC profile against required Azure permissions
test_cases.expected_result: Restricted strictly to Key Vault Secrets User and Cognitive Services User
test_cases.evidence: Least privilege policy enforced: only {'Cognitive Services OpenAI User', 'Key Vault Secrets User'} permitted

test_cases.name: API key fallback mode
test_cases.expected_result: System falls back cleanly to API key authentication
test_cases.evidence: API key fallback active; auth method switched cleanly without Managed Identity

test_cases.name: Token proactive refresh
test_cases.input_setup: Simulate token expiration lifecycle with 5-minute initial validity
test_cases.expected_result: Proactive refresh scheduled before token reaches expiry boundary
test_cases.evidence: Proactive token refresh triggered at 4m10s (50s before 5m expiry)

test_cases.name: Cross-tenant isolation enforcement
test_cases.expected_result: Raises 403 immediately; aborts without entering infinite retry loop
test_cases.evidence: Cross-tenant 403 authorization error marked non-retryable; terminates immediately
